$comment: Tracks the Modern Web Guidance catalog drift state for web-uplift. tests/mwg-drift-check.mjs maintains the lastCheck* fields across recurring upstream checks. analysedVersion and analysedAt describe the last full reanalysis and must move together with knowledge/mwg-catalog.json version and retrievedAt. Downstream mwg-train artefact fields (hash, canonicalisation, appliedRulesVersion) are added by web-uplift-vbv.
